public.text: The proposed approach may be difficult for countries without ArchiMate, FHIR, IHE, testing, or certification expertise. Without a proportional adoption model, conformance could become a barrier to implementation.
public.suggestedRevision: Provide progressive conformance levels, beginning with published specifications and basic validation, then interface testing, interoperable workflow testing, formal certification, and continuous operational conformance as national capacity grows.
